_comment_1: The only permissions the deploy role needs. Replace <REGION>, <ACCOUNT_ID> and <INSTANCE_ID>.
_comment_2: SendCommand needs BOTH resources: the instance it runs on and the document it runs. Naming only the instance leaves the document unrestricted, which means any SSM document — including ones that read files off the box — and naming only the document leaves the fleet open.
_comment_3: GetCommandInvocation cannot be scoped to a resource; it is read-only and returns the output of a command this role already had to be allowed to send.
_comment_4: Do not replace this with AmazonSSMFullAccess. That grants Session Manager, which is an interactive root shell on every instance in the account, to anything that can trigger a workflow in this repository.
